Show a Specific Rule

Source: R/rules.R
show_rule.Rd

show_rule() prints the logical expression that defines one rule of a fitted model. The rule identifiers are in the label column of the rules element of the model (see rule_ensemble-object).

Usage

show_rule(x, id)

Arguments

x

An object with class "rule_ensemble".

id

A single character value for the rule identifier (e.g. "rule_01").

Value

The rule expression, invisibly.

Examples

if (rlang::is_installed("xgboost")) {
  set.seed(1)
  fit <- rule_ensemble(mpg ~ ., data = mtcars, trees = 5)
  show_rule(fit, fit$rules$label[1])
}
#> Rule: "rule_01"
#> cyl < 6 & wt < 2.31999993
